abilities.name: NullAbility
abilities.verification: Faithfully unusable: the public ABI rejects id 0 like NativeAOT, while 18 retained clone-instantiation goldens preserve the shipped prefab failure caused by its missing FixTransform; supplied empty-callback InstantAbility graphs are separately covered.

abilities.name: Random
abilities.verification: Spawn-time replacement matches GameSessionHandler across exact seeded draws, ids 2..38, authored cooldowns, and the all-Random offensive fallback; random_ability_ab compares 72 NativeAOT/Rust slots.

abilities.name: Grenade
abilities.verification: grenade_ability_ab and grenade_fuse_ab each match 700 NativeAOT/Rust ticks; grenade_air_ab matches 100. Together they cover grounded and aerial ThrowItem2 entry, charged release, slow-gravity aiming, aerial recoil/control and raycast landing, recoil/body split, delayed owner contact, held-position fuse expiry, deferred explosion, both startup shockwaves, first-frame self-kill, 90-frame lifetime, stock choice, fast respawn and landing. Terrain bounce, non-owner hits, duplication, and forced exits remain open.

abilities.name: Engine
abilities.verification: engine_ability_ab matches 500 exact NativeAOT/Rust Q32 ticks through grounded placement, cast and recovery callbacks, scaled RocketEngine registration, persistent layer-21 box export, composite mass/inertia, cast impulse, startup delay, the full fixed thrust curve, platform spring re-homing, and composite platform collision response. Smoke ignition is source-ported; dedicated smoke-chain, four-slot ring eviction, scale-change, platform-destruction, time-stop, and multi-engine scenarios remain to be goldened.

abilities.name: Blink gun
abilities.verification: blink_ability_ab matches 500 NativeAOT/Rust Q32 ticks through grounded GunTransform entry, release hitscan, five-second hit cooldown, immediate QuantumTunnel hiding, exact seeded platform selection and surface sampling, relocation while inactive, strict 1.2-second lifetime, reactivation, and delayed Player.Position publication. Wall/rigid/item/orb tunnel targets, water reflection, active-form victims, ropes/magnets, and airborne relocation still need dedicated goldens.

abilities.name: Gust
abilities.verification: Public rollout executes the measured QuickSpell cast/exit, active circle, deferred AirWave Shockwave, exact target capture, player/platform impulses, force curve, and entity observations; gust_ability_ab compares 360 complete NativeAOT/Rust ticks. Cross-ability targets expand with each concrete ability port.

abilities.name: Growth ray
abilities.verification: scale_rays_ab matches 500 NativeAOT/Rust Q32 ticks through grounded GunTransform entry, release, Growth ScaleChanger registration, the complete fixed Hermite scale curve, Player.Scale clamping, one-pass-lagged PlayerPhysics radius, and DPhysicsBox inverse-extents rounding. Water reflection, non-player targets, active-form targets, BlackHole growth and orb conversion remain open.

abilities.name: Rock
abilities.verification: rock_ability_ab matches 500 NativeAOT/Rust Q32 ticks through grounded transformation, rigid circle gravity/bounce/friction, authored pulse scale, strict 2.5-second lifetime, exit shrink, and slime restoration. rock_contact_ab matches 360 ticks and the same-tick lethal player callback, ownership, telemetry, and stock recovery. Dynamic vectors and pulse scale are within 64 raw Q32 units (1.49e-8 game units) from ordered curve/normalization rounding, with identical collision and lifecycle decisions. Shockwave, projectile/item detonation, scale changes, arrows attaching to Rock, and mixed transformed-form contacts remain to be separately goldened.

abilities.name: Missile
abilities.verification: missile_ability_ab matches 500 exact NativeAOT/Rust Q32 ticks through grounded SparkShot entry, guided steering, stabilization, release, instability thrust, box/rounded collision resolution and correction, callback destruction, MineExplosion registration, one-shot Shockwave, first-frame lethal-box disable, and visual lifetime. Projectile/item/form collisions, time-stop and scale interactions, Item.Duplicate, and dedicated explosion-lethality scenarios remain to be goldened.

abilities.name: Spike
abilities.verification: spike_ability_ab matches 500 exact NativeAOT/Rust ticks through grounded cast/recovery, far-side raycast placement, manual collider registration, down-thrust curve, persistent lethal box export, composite mass/inertia, cast impulse, neighboring-wall collision resolution and bilateral push. Recast replacement and dedicated player-lethality scenarios remain to be goldened.

abilities.name: Smoke
abilities.verification: smoke_ability_ab matches 800 exact NativeAOT/Rust Q32 ticks through grounded ThrowItem2 entry, charged release, ballistic flight, the strict five-second fuse, all randomized cloud offsets and rotations, cloud registration, enter-radius animation, and persistent layer-22 entity export. Explosion ignition/chaining, scale changes, repeated-cast ring eviction, and Item.Duplicate still need dedicated goldens.

abilities.name: Revival
abilities.verification: Public rollout executes the measured QuickSpell cast/exit, active circle, deferred RevivePositionIndicator registration, exact shape-group observation order, marker replacement, and camera/water clamp; revival_ability_ab compares 650 complete NativeAOT/Rust ticks exactly. revival_death_ab compares 900 exact ticks through boundary death, hidden copied clone registration, distance-derived wisp/particle delay, marker removal, spawn animation and launch. Multiple simultaneous markers still require the general multi-clone rollout representation.

abilities.name: Roll
abilities.verification: roll_ability_ab matches 500 NativeAOT/Rust Q32 ticks through grounded form entry, one-second charge, serialized Hermite speed, allocation-free n/(n+1) swept surface motion, lethal-circle export, jump cancel, exact launch velocity, boundary death, and stock reconstruction. Curved-surface position reconstruction differs by at most 2,048 raw Q32 units (<0.0000005 world units) without a zone, contact, or state difference. Platform hopping, isolated early airborne release, moving-platform turns, wall squish, and mixed transformed-form contacts still need dedicated goldens.

abilities.name: Shrink ray
abilities.verification: scale_rays_ab matches 500 NativeAOT/Rust Q32 ticks through grounded GunTransform entry, release, Shrink ScaleChanger registration, the complete fixed Hermite scale curve, Player.Scale clamping, one-pass-lagged PlayerPhysics radius, and DPhysicsBox inverse-extents rounding. Water reflection, non-player targets, active-form targets, BlackHole growth and orb conversion remain open.

abilities.name: Black hole
abilities.verification: black_hole_ability_ab compares 500 NativeAOT/Rust Q32 ticks through grounded BlackHoleClap entry, exact persistent hole spawn identity, fixed Hermite growth, whole-map platform attraction, center-only wall destruction/removal, player attraction, the no-death-effect callback kill, and exact stock-clone reconstruction boundaries. Hole radius differs by about 100 raw Q32 units; the active form position differs by at most 70,000,000 raw units (0.0163 world units) before both backends reproject to the exact same grounded exit pose. Standalone projectile/item attraction and consumption remain to be composed and goldened.

abilities.name: Invisibility
abilities.verification: Public rollout plus composed actor runtime reproduce the instant cast, strict five-second expiry, player clocks/flags, 10,000-second live sentinel, six-second restoration, duplicate-slot chaining and telemetry. invisibility_ab matches NativeAOT for 637 ticks.

abilities.name: Meteor
abilities.verification: meteor_ability_ab matches 1,500 NativeAOT/Rust Q32 ticks across short grounded release, maximum two-second charge, and airborne entry. It covers anticipation/jump/vibration timing, normalized random shake, downward landing, charge-scaled ground impulse, deferred Shockwave forces, one-second platform shake, two-tick smear export/removal, collider handoff, and post-landing movement. Position/axis comparisons allow 50,000 raw Q32 units (<0.000012 world units) for separately rounded FixTransform and normalized-vector fields; platform dynamics match exactly in the measured casts. Ray hits on players/items, DropAllAttachedPlayers, and isolated water/no-hit exits still need dedicated interaction goldens.

abilities.name: Throw
abilities.verification: macho_throw_ability_ab compares two 500-tick NativeAOT/Rust Q32 scenarios through the grounded form, exact entry/pickup/begin-throw/exit callbacks, eight authored ground-shrink passes, quick and fully held boulder creation, launch, rounded-platform collision response, exit, boulder-caused death, and exact stock-clone reconstruction. Quick spawn/launch is tick 226; the held boulder spawns at 256, launches at 279, kills at 461, and the clone registers at 462. Shrinking collider axes differ by at most four raw Q32 units from reciprocal round trips; positions, velocities and lifecycle boundaries are exact. Transfer of Spike, Engine, Tesla and rope attachments from the consumed platform to the boulder remains to be composed and goldened.

abilities.name: Push
abilities.verification: push_ability_ab matches 420 NativeAOT/Rust Q32 ticks through grounded entry, exact box activation and offset basis, 120 frames of platform force/torque and AnimateVelocity home retargeting, ten-tick channel animation, release, inactive collider, and restored slime movement. Platform destruction, sudden death, and overlapping-player scenarios remain to be separately goldened.

abilities.name: Tesla coil
abilities.verification: tesla_ability_ab matches 900 NativeAOT/Rust Q32 ticks across three grounded placements. It covers PlantObjectOnPlatform cast/recovery, scaled circle registration, composite mass/inertia and cast impulse, two-node connection, deferred lightning registration, staggered lethal activation, the five-second flicker cycle, one-tick destroyed-line publication, and two-slot ring eviction/reconnection. Entity positions differ by at most 16 raw Q32 units in the golden from fixed-point root/collider reconstruction. tesla_contact_ab matches the discrete death and telemetry stream for a separated-node owner contact over 700 ticks, including the uncredited tick-381 kill. Scale changes, platform destruction, time stop, smoke/mine ignition, and mixed attachment scenarios remain to be separately goldened.

abilities.name: Mine
abilities.verification: mine_ability_ab matches 334 NativeAOT/Rust Q32 ticks through the original grounded ThrowItem form, deferred autonomous circle registration, hover, two-second arming, opponent scan/chase, player ignition, anticipation, jitter, owner-credited MineExplosion kill, first-frame hitbox disable, and stock recovery. Entity vector differences are bounded to 64 raw Q32 units after chase normalization and shockwave response; the form center differs by at most 5,000 raw units from PlayerPhysics ground reprojection. Item.Duplicate, scale changes, boundary effects, held-magnet behavior, and dedicated projectile/explosion ignition cases remain to be goldened.

abilities.name: Teleport
abilities.verification: Exact public Q32 goldens cover the first-cast marker, release-to-ready second cast, single-caster transfer, two-way three-player area swap, disabled-object interval, four RNG samples per effect tick, reactivation, entity ordering and teammate spawn offsets for 300/450 ticks. Projectile/item/boulder targets remain pending on those entity ports.

abilities.name: Rewind
abilities.verification: rewind_ability_ab matches 300 NativeAOT/Rust Q32 ticks across recorded grounded and aerial movement, 150-tick history selection, 102-tick smootherstep/Catmull-Rom playback, input and physics suppression, platform raycast force, destination velocity/rotation/cooldown restoration, arrival depenetration and retained-ground release.

abilities.name: Poke ball
abilities.verification: Public rollout reproduces Poke Ball's shared grounded/aerial ThrowItem2 form, pooled bouncy item, owner binding, strict five-second fizzle, nearest eligible opponent selection, invulnerable invisible pinned ragdoll, prefab-overridden 1.92-second capture, and fast upward ejection. poke_ball_ability_ab is exact for the no-hit path; poke_ball_capture_ab preserves exact capture/release ticks and scalar state across 500 NativeAOT/Rust ticks with bounded movement-history drift. Item.Duplicate and isolated boundary/time-stop interactions remain open.

abilities.name: Gold mushroom
abilities.verification: Public rollout reproduces SuperStar's instant cast, next-pass effect initialization, four-second lifetime, airborne 0.85-strength jump override, 10,000-second live sentinel and five-second restored cooldown. gold_mushroom_ab matches NativeAOT exactly for 636 ticks.

abilities.name: Tack
abilities.verification: tack_ability_ab matches 1,450 NativeAOT/Rust Q32 ticks through aerial ThrowItem2 entry, charged release, deferred Projectile owner binding, ballistic landing, stable pinning and strict 20-second expiry. tack_kill_ab matches 400 ticks through the 0.8-second arm delay, owner-clear immunity, re-entry kill, updater-phase removal and stock-choice prefix. Item.Duplicate remains open.

abilities.name: Freeze ray
abilities.verification: freeze_ability_ab matches 1,000 NativeAOT/Rust Q32 ticks across a grounded ordinary-player hit through immediate detach, 1.6-second FrozenSolid pin, cooldown reset, thaw impulse and ragdoll landing, plus an airborne diagonal cast through recoil and fire-animation exit. Water reflection is source-ported but un-goldened. A measured active-Bow-form hit has an unresolved cross-prefab updater-order mismatch during restoration and freeze.

abilities.name: Mjolnir
abilities.verification: mjolnir_ability_ab and mjolnir_wall_ab each match 1,450 NativeAOT/Rust Q32 ticks. They cover aerial and grounded ThrowItem2 forms, charged release, deferred Projectile owner binding, signed spin, outbound drag, stall- and wall-clang return transitions, recall acceleration and speed clamp, repeated platform force, and owner catch. Victim hits and Item.Duplicate remain open.
